```{r}
  is_obj_list_filt[[i]] <- obj
}

is_merged_list_filt <- list()
for (i in seq_along(is_merged_list)){
  obj <- is_merged_list[[i]]
  obj <- subset(obj, subset = nCount_RNA < 20000 & percent.mt < 5 & nFeature_RNA < 5000 & nFeature_RNA > 500)
  is_merged_list_filt[[i]] <- obj
}
```

# Processing (Normalize, scale, dim reduc)
```{r}
for (i in seq_along(is_obj_list_filt)) {
    obj <- is_obj_list_filt[[i]]
    cat("Processing", names(is_obj_list_filt[i]), "\n")
    
    m.s.genes <- str_to_title(cc.genes.updated.2019$s.genes)
    m.s.genes <- m.s.genes[m.s.genes %in% rownames(obj)]
    m.g2m.genes <- str_to_title(cc.genes.updated.2019$g2m.genes)
    m.g2m.genes <- m.g2m.genes[m.g2m.genes %in% rownames(obj)]
    
    # obj <- SCTransform(obj, vars.to.regress = "percent.mt")
    
    obj <- NormalizeData(obj, normalization.method = "LogNormalize")
    obj <- CellCycleScoring(obj, s.features = m.s.genes, g2m.features = m.g2m.genes)
    obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj, nfeatures = 2000)
    obj <- ScaleData(obj, vars.to.regress = c("S.Score","G2M.Score","percent.mt"))
    obj <- RunPCA(obj, npcs = 30)
    obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims = 1:30)
    obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, dims = 1:30)
    obj <- FindClusters(obj, resolution = 0.7)

    is_obj_list_filt[[i]] <- obj
}
```


# Find Doublets
```{r}          

for (seu in seq_along(is_obj_list_filt)) {
  obj <- is_obj_list_filt[[seu]]
  doublet_obj <- run_doubletfinder_custom(obj, used_sct = F, min_pc = 30)
  doublet_obj <- doublet_obj[, doublet_obj@meta.data[["df_col"]] == "Singlet"] # filter doublets out
  is_obj_list_filt[[seu]] <- doublet_obj
}

qsave(is_obj_list_filt, paste0("data/Immunosuppressors/IS_Oct2026/IS_unintegrated_doubletfinder_obj_list_", Sys.Date(),".qs"))
```

# Integration
```{r}
is_obj_list_filt <- qread("data/Immunosuppressors/IS_Oct2026/IS_unintegrated_doubletfinder_obj_list_2026-10-19.qs")

features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = is_obj_list_filt)
anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = is_obj_list_filt, dims = 1:30)
integrated <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors, dims = 1:30)

# integrated <- Run.STACAS(is_obj_list_filt, anchor.features = 2000)

integrated <- ScaleData(integrated, vars.to.regress = c("S.Score","G2M.Score","percent.mt"))
integrated <- RunPCA(integrated, npcs = 30)
integrated <- RunUMAP(integrated, dims = 1:30)
integrated <- FindNeighbors(integrated, dims  = 1:30)
integrated <- FindClusters(integrated, graph.name = "integrated_snn", resolution = 0.5) # changed it to 0.3

# Change sample naming so it looks better in plots, and rename 236 as 236_Ctrl

table(integrated$sample_type)

# qsave(integrated, paste0("data/Immunosuppressors_Oct2026/STACAS_IS_integrated_lognorm_",Sys.Date(),".qs"))
DefaultAssay(integrated) <- "RNA"
integrated <- JoinLayers(integrated)
qsave(integrated, paste0("data/Immunosuppressors/IS_Oct2026/IS_integrated_lognorm_",Sys.Date(),".qs"))

rm(obj, anchors, doublet_obj, is_obj_list, is_obj_list_filt, is_merged, is_merged_list, is_merged_list_filt)
gc()
```

# Feature plots of relevant genes
```{r}
my_genes <- c("Bcl6", "Eomes", "Foxp3", "Il7r", "Maf", "Prdm1", "Irf4", "Il10", "Il10ra")

featplot_dir <- "figures/Immunosuppressors_Oct2026/Feature_plots/IS_Feature_Plots/"
dir.create(featplot_dir ,recursive = TRUE)
n_groups <- ceiling(length(my_genes) / 3)
n_groups
DefaultAssay(integrated) <- "RNA"
for (i in 1:n_groups) {
  start_idx <- (i-1)*3 + 1
  end_idx <- min(i*3, length(my_genes))
  current_genes <- my_genes[start_idx:end_idx]
  plot_list <- list()
  valid_genes <- c()  # Track genes that exist in the object
  for (gene in current_genes) {
    print(gene)
    tryCatch({
      plot_list[[gene]] <- FeaturePlot(integrated, features = gene, pt.size = 0.5, label = TRUE)
      valid_genes <- c(valid_genes, gene) # Only add if successful
      # print(valid_genes) 
    }, error = function(e) {
      message(paste("Skipping gene", gene, ":", e$message))
    })
  }
  if (length(valid_genes) == 0) {
    message("No valid genes in group ", i, ". Skipping.")
    next
  }
  combined_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(plot_list[valid_genes], ncol = length(valid_genes))
  genes_in_filename <- paste(valid_genes, collapse = "_")
  ggsave(
    paste0(featplot_dir, "feature_plot_", genes_in_filename, "_", Sys.Date(), ".svg"),
    plot = combined_plot,
    width = 8 * length(plot_list),
    height = 9  ) 
}



```









# Heatmap of all genes
```{r}
integrated <- qread("data/Immunosuppressors/Annotated_IS_subsetted_integrated_lognorm_2026-01-28.qs")
dir.create("output/Immunosuppressors_Oct2026/Avg_Expr_heatmaps/")
DefaultAssay(integrated) <- "RNA"
is_int_list_all <- SplitObject(integrated,
                              split.by = "sample_type")

is_int_list_all
# Average expression heatmap table for all genes for the 6 subsets (2026-01-21)

for (seu in names(is_int_list_all)){
  obj <- is_int_list_all[[seu]]
  print(seu) 
  Idents(obj) <- "celltype"
  table(obj$celltype)
  
  # avg_expr <- AverageExpression(obj, return.seurat = TRUE, layer = "data") 
  aggr_expr <- AggregateExpression(obj, return.seurat = T, slot = "data")
  avg_data <- as.data.frame(aggr_expr[["RNA"]]$data) # data layer contains log normalized average expression values for each gene
  
  n_clusters <- ncol(avg_data)
  
  # grep("^Zfp68", rownames(obj), value = T, ignore.case = T)
  # filter to only include genes expressed in more than 50% of the clusters and that have an average expression higher than 0.5
  avg_data_filtered <- avg_data %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    # mutate(
    #   num_clusters_expressed = rowSums(select(., -gene) > 0.5), # if expr is higher than 0.5, consider it as "expressed"
    #   prct_clusters_expressed = paste0(((num_clusters_expressed / n_clusters)*100), "%"),
    #   avg_expression = round(rowMeans(select(., -gene)),3)
    # ) %>%
    # mutate_at(vars(starts_with("Cluster")), ~(round(.,3))) %>%
    # filter(frac_clusters_expressed >= 0.5 & avg_expression >= 1) %>%
    mutate(across(-gene, ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
    filter(!grepl("^mt-|Rp", gene)) %>%
    arrange(gene)
  # reorder columns
  avg_data_filtered <- avg_data_filtered[,c("gene", "TFH",  "TR1.1", "TR1.2","Foxp3+ TR1.2", "Eomes+ TR1", "Eomes+Prdm1+ TR1")]
  # only run this for annotated clusters
  # avg_data_filtered <- avg_data_filtered[,c("gene", "Cluster 1","Cluster 2","Cluster 3","Cluster 4","Cluster 5","Cluster 6","Cluster 7","Cluster 8",
  #                                           "num_clusters_expressed", "prct_clusters_expressed", "avg_expression")]
  
  write.xlsx(avg_data_filtered, paste0("output/Immunosuppressors_Oct2026/Avg_Expr_heatmaps/",seu,"_Average_Expr_all_genes_",Sys.Date(),".xlsx"))
}
```

```{r}
#   )) %>%
#   mutate(celltype = fct_rev(celltype))
prop_df <- integrated@meta.data %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  group_by(celltype, sample_type) %>% summarise(N_cells = n()) %>%
  group_by(sample_type) %>% 
  filter(!celltype %in% c("Unknown")) %>%  
  mutate(Perc_cells = round(N_cells/sum(N_cells)*100, 2)) %>% # percentage in my sample
  arrange(sample_type) %>%
  mutate(celltype = factor(celltype,
    levels = c("TFH","TR1.1","TR1.2","Foxp3+ TR1.2","Eomes+ TR1","Eomes+Prdm1+ TR1")
  )) %>%
  mutate(celltype = fct_rev(celltype))

  geom_bar(stat="identity") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  ggtitle(paste0("Immunosuppressed samples - Absolute Proportion Plot")) +
  ylab("Single Cell Count") +
  ggprism::theme_prism() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_cd4_celltype, breaks = rev(levels(prop_df$celltype)))
prop_plot

ggsave(paste0("figures/Immunosuppressors_Oct2026/Prop_Bar_Plots/IS_Absolute_prop_barplot_",Sys.Date(),".svg"), prop_plot, width = 12, height = 10)
```

```{r}
  group_by(predicted.id, sample_type) %>% summarise(N_cells = n()) %>%
  group_by(sample_type) %>% 
  filter(!predicted.id %in% c("Unknown")) %>%  
  mutate(Perc_cells = round(N_cells/sum(N_cells)*100, 2)) %>% # percentage in my sample
  arrange(sample_type) %>%
  mutate(celltype = factor(predicted.id,
    levels = c("TFH","TR1.1","TR1.2","Foxp3+TR1.2")
  ))

# write.xlsx(prop_df, "output/Expt56/tetpos_percentages_no_TFR.xlsx")
# View(prop_df)

prop_plot_rel <- ggplot(prop_df_rel, aes(sample_type, Perc_cells, fill = celltype)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  ggtitle(paste0("Immunosuppressed samples - Relative Proportion Plot")) +
  ylab("Percentage") +
  ggprism::theme_prism() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_cd4_celltype, breaks = levels(prop_df_rel$celltype))
prop_plot_rel

ggsave(paste0("figures/Immunosuppressors_Oct2026/Prop_Bar_Plots/IS_Relative_prop_barplot_",Sys.Date(),".svg"), prop_plot_rel, width = 12, height = 10)
```

# Compare each cell type subset in the immunosuppressed sample to non-IS version? BDC vs BDC IS, BDC + OX40 vs BDC OX40 IS
```{r}
integrated <- qread("data/Immunosuppressors/IS_Oct2026/IS_integrated_lognorm_2026-10-19.qs")
DefaultAssay(integrated) <- "RNA"

table(integrated$sample_type)
comparisons <- list(
  Azathioprine = c("T1_Azathioprine", "Control_1"),
  Elafibranor = c("T2_Elafibranor", "Control_2"),
  MMF = c("T3_MMF","Control_3")
)

Idents(integrated) <- "sample_type"
for (ct in unique(integrated$predicted.id)){
  message("Cell type: ", ct)
  obj_ct <- integrated[, integrated$predicted.id == ct]

  for (cmp in names(comparisons)){
    group1 <- comparisons[[cmp]][1]  # treatment
    group2 <- comparisons[[cmp]][2]  # ctrl
    message("  Comparison: ", group1, " vs ", group2)
    
    markers <- tryCatch({
                            FindMarkers(obj_ct,
                            assay = "RNA",
                            slot = "data",
                            logfc.threshold = 0.5,
                            ident.1 = group1, # ctrl
                            ident.2 = group2, # treatment
                            test.use = "wilcox", 
                            min.cells.group = 25,
                            min.pct = 0.25, # min.pct = the minimum percent of cells in a cluster that expresses a marker (pct.1)
                            only.pos = FALSE, 
                            min.diff.pct = 0.1 # minimum difference between pct.1 and pct.2 for each marker
                            ) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
    },
    error = function(e) {
    message("  Failed for ", ct, " / ", cmp, ": ", e$message)
    return(NULL)
    })
    if (is.null(markers)) next

    # markers <- markers[order(markers$avg_log2FC, decreasing = TRUE),]
    # write.csv(file = paste0("output/Expt56/",ct,"_between_samples/",ko,"vs_Cysko_10x_main_",ct,"_markers_between_samples_", Sys.Date(),".csv"),
    #           markers)
    # dir.create("output/Immunosuppressors_Oct2026/DE_analysis/")
    out_dir <- file.path("output","Immunosuppressors_Oct2026","DE_analysis", paste0(ct, "_between_samples"))
    dir.create(out_dir, recursive = T, showWarnings = F)
    write.xlsx(markers, 
             file = paste0(out_dir,"/", cmp,"_vs_ctrl_",ct,"_DE_markers_", Sys.Date(),".xlsx"))
    vol <- make_volcano(markers, paste0(cmp, " relative to Control markers: ", ct), fc_threshold = 1)
    ggsave(paste0("figures/Immunosuppressors_Oct2026/Volcanos/", cmp, "_vs_ctrl_", ct, "_volcano_", Sys.Date(), ".svg"), vol, width = 8, height = 9)
  }
}
```

```{r}

sig <- read.xlsx("output/Immunosuppressors_Oct2026/signature_markers/IS_Oct2026_markers_2026-10-21.xlsx")

signature_genes_by_type <- split(
  as.character(sig$gene),
  as.character(sig$cluster)
)

signature_genes_by_type <- lapply(signature_genes_by_type, unique)
signature_genes_by_type
signature_results <- list()


for (ct in names(signature_genes_by_type)) {

  message("Cell type: ", ct)

  cells_ct <- colnames(integrated)[
    !is.na(integrated$predicted.id) &
      integrated$predicted.id == ct
  ]

  if (length(cells_ct) == 0L) next

  obj_ct <- integrated[, cells_ct]

  genes_ct <- intersect(
    signature_genes_by_type[[ct]],
    rownames(obj_ct[["RNA"]])
  )

  if (length(genes_ct) == 0L) next

  for (cmp in names(comparisons)) {

    treatment <- comparisons[[cmp]][1]
    control   <- comparisons[[cmp]][2]

    n_treatment <- sum(obj_ct$sample_type == treatment, na.rm = TRUE)
    n_control   <- sum(obj_ct$sample_type == control, na.rm = TRUE)

    if (min(n_treatment, n_control) < 25) {
      message("Skipping ", ct, " / ", cmp, ": fewer than 25 cells")
      next
    }

    result <- tryCatch(
      {
        FindMarkers(
          object = obj_ct,
          assay = "RNA",
          slot = "data",
          group.by = "sample_type",
          ident.1 = treatment,
          ident.2 = control,
          features = genes_ct,
          test.use = "wilcox",
          logfc.threshold = 0,
          min.pct = 0,
          min.diff.pct = -Inf,
          min.cells.group = 25,
          only.pos = FALSE
        ) %>%
          tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            celltype = ct,
            comparison = cmp,
            treatment = treatment,
            control = control,
            n_treatment = n_treatment,
            n_control = n_control
          ) %>%
          dplyr::select(
            celltype, gene, comparison, treatment, control,
            avg_log2FC, p_val, p_val_adj,
            pct.1, pct.2, n_treatment, n_control
          )
      },
      error = function(e) {
        message("Failed: ", ct, " / ", cmp, ": ", e$message)
        NULL
      }
    )

    signature_results[[paste(ct, cmp, sep = "_")]] <- result
  }
}

signature_de <- dplyr::bind_rows(signature_results)
write.xlsx(signature_de, paste0("output/Immunosuppressors_Oct2026/signature_markers/comparison_of_sig_markers_treatment_vs_ctrl_", Sys.Date(), ".xlsx"))

signature_de %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    gene == "Il10",
    celltype %in% c("TR1.2", "Foxp3+TR1.2")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    celltype, comparison,
    avg_log2FC, p_val, p_val_adj,
    pct.1, pct.2
  )
```
